# Handwrite.io

Handwrite.io creates and tracks physical handwritten card orders using selectable handwriting and stationery styles.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/handwrite/.

## Actions

- **Get Order** (read-only): Get a Handwrite order by ID, including its current status, test or live environment, addresses, and proof images when available.
- **List Handwriting Styles** (read-only): List the handwriting styles available to the connected Handwrite account, including the style ID required when sending cards and a preview…
- **List Stationery** (read-only): List public stationery and custom stationery available to the connected Handwrite account, including the card ID required when sending…
- **Send Handwritten Cards**: Create handwritten-card orders for one or more recipients.
